  "memo": "R08 holds because the address is shared by four accounts. Although shipping is to the account's home, its recent registration prevents the household exception. Linkage is the only adverse family; all other rule conditions are unmet, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Ordinary household sharing remains plausible, while coordinated identity creation is unconfirmed. With no checks completed, recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold for id_check. Contact is not required. No installments were due, so repayment intent cannot support an adverse recommendation. The memo is advisory and sets no queue priority."
